objective: Add a complete local AES ZIP bundle and read-only decryption verification slice.

acceptance.behavior: Add pack PATH... --root ROOT --output-dir DIR --json and verify DIR [--password-file FILE] --json; preserve plan and all FD001 behavior. Python>=3.11. Archive dependency is optional extra archive=[pyzipper==0.4.0]; plain plan install remains standard-library-only. Missing optional dependency yields DEPENDENCY_MISSING exit2 without traceback. Export archive.pack(paths,root,output_dir) and archive.verify(bundle_dir,password_file=None) returning JSON-serializable dictionaries.

pack calls existing planner and creates new output directory outside root containing exactly archive.zip, manifest.json (the planned manifest), password.txt. AES-256 WinZip AES ZIP_DEFLATED, root-relative POSIX entries exactly matching manifest; no plaintext file content in archive. Generate fresh cryptographic random password with >=128 bits entropy for each bundle. Decrypt every entry and compare size/SHA256 before reporting packaged; Unicode, spaces, overlapping inputs and empty files supported.

Output directory mode0700 and all three files0600; password stored only in password.txt and memory, never stdout/stderr/exceptions. Success JSON schema_version1,status=packaged,bundle_dir,archive_path,manifest_path,password_file,file_count,total_bytes,archive_sha256; never returns password. No network, upload, email or input writes. WinZip AES leaves filenames visible: do not claim filename encryption.

Reject output equal to or nested inside input root (OUTPUT_NOT_ALLOWED), existing directory/file/symlink output (OUTPUT_EXISTS), missing/invalid parent (IO_ERROR); do not overwrite. Stage in private sibling directory, clean partial artifacts on handled failure; final bundle only published after verified. All planner errors preserved. Re-read content during packaging and verify it matches initial manifest; mismatch INPUT_CHANGED, no final bundle. This is observed-change detection not an adversarial snapshot guarantee.

verify reads bundle manifest,password,archive without extracting or altering them. Success status=verified with file_count,total_bytes,archive_sha256. Wrong password, corrupted archive, changed manifest/hash, unexpected/missing/duplicate entries, unencrypted or nonAES256 entries, absolute/traversing archive names all fail exit2 code VERIFY_FAILED. Validate manifest schema1/planned and entry types/unique safe paths/count/sum. Verification failures must not disclose password or file contents.

All valid operation failures emit JSON status=error,error.code,error.message exit2; IO_ERROR for output IO failures. Existing 18 controller checks remain passing, meaningful Worker tests cover new behavior; independently decrypt using 7-Zip CLI when available in controller, plus pyzipper. No new provider binding, state DB or custom cryptography.
